ideas.name: any warning after a 2-year yield shock
ideas.why: the 2-year yield moved 8bp+ the day before: policy expectations repricing, which equity desks keep trading into the next session, so moves carry and turns fail

ideas.name: any warning calling against yesterday's 10-year move
ideas.why: Nasdaq trades against long yields; after a 5bp+ move in the 10-year, a turn the way the bond move favours (long after yields fell, short after they rose) has the rates flow behind it

ideas.name: any warning against the dollar's week
ideas.why: a dollar up 0.5%+ over five readings tightens conditions for global holders of US tech; turns calling short then (long after a falling dollar) have that flow behind them

ideas.name: any warning after credit spreads widened
ideas.why: high-yield spreads 15bp+ wider over five days is stress: forced de-risking overshoots both ways intraday, and turns pay
